function.arguments: {"command":"python -c \"import pandas as p; d=p.read_csv('measurements.csv'); print(len(d)); print(d.time_s.diff().dropna().describe().to_string()); print('zero widths', (d.correlation_width==0).sum()); print('nonfinite inverse', (~p.Series(d.inverse_correlation_length_normalized).map(lambda x: p.notna(x) and abs(x)!=float('inf'))).sum())\""}
